create_resnet_model: create a ResNet model with configurable depth, normalization, and bottleneck blocks
build_resnet_v1_block: build a ResNet V1 residual block with optional bottleneck and projection shortcut
build_resnet_v2_block: build a ResNet V2 residual block with pre-activation normalization and optional bottleneck
construct_block_group: construct a block group containing multiple ResNet blocks with configurable stride and projection
run_resnet_forward: run a ResNet forward pass returning feature maps from each block group
